Latin word

vulgāris

vulgāris, vulgāre

Declension on Wiktionary

common, ordinary, met with everywhere; current, common (of an opinion)

In this lexicon

  • common

    the recommended word · classical · Phaedr. 3.9.1: vulgāre amīcī nōmen; Cic. de Or. 1.248: in commūnī vītā et vulgārī hominum cōnsuētūdine (Lewis & Short)

  • current

    also used · classical · Traupman 299

Examples

  • vulgāre amīcī nōmen, sed rāra est fidēs

    the name of friend is common, but loyalty is rarePhaedr. 3.9.1

  • quibus nōn vulgāris in cursū gradus, sed mollis alternō crūrum explicātū glomerātiō
